user.title: Add a LibreSync hub
user.description: Enter the hub's address on your network.

data_description.host: The IP address or host name of the hub, for example 192.168.1.50. Your router's list of connected devices shows it.

discovery_confirm.title: Add {name}?
discovery_confirm.description: Home Assistant found this LibreSync hub on your network.

error.cannot_connect: Nothing answered at that address. Check that the hub is powered and on the same network.
error.no_identity: This hub is reachable but is not publishing its identity, so Home Assistant cannot tell it apart from another one. Unplug it from the mains, plug it back in, wait a minute, and try again.

abort.already_configured: This hub is already set up.
abort.already_in_progress: This hub is already being set up.
abort.cannot_connect: The device that was found did not answer on the control port, so it is not a LibreSync hub.

cannot_connect.message: The hub at {host} did not answer on ports 50006 and 7777. Home Assistant will keep trying.

invalid_source.message: The hub has no source named {source}.

not_confirmed.message: The hub did not confirm the command in time, so it may not have taken effect.

not_connected.message: The hub is not connected, so the command was not sent. Home Assistant is reconnecting.
